title: Coordination Based Passivation Builder Parameters Schema

coordination_threshold.description: The coordination number threshold for an atom to be considered undercoordinated

bonds_to_passivate.description: The maximum number of bonds to passivate for each undercoordinated atom

symmetry_tolerance.description: The tolerance for symmetry comparison of vectors for bonds

shadowing_radius.description: Radius around each surface atom to exclude underlying atoms from passivation

depth.description: Depth from the topmost (or bottommost) atom into the material to consider for passivation, accounting for features like islands, adatoms, and terraces
